name: dictml-ls
description: Glossary keys, macros and linters of the Dictionary of Applied Machine Learning, in the editor.

dictml.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Interpreter used to run the server. The server is **stdlib only**, so any Python 3.8+ works — including the one on `PATH`. Set an absolute path only if `python3` is missing from the environment VS Code launches with.

dictml.serverPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to `scripts/dictml_lsp.py`. Empty means: look for it under the first workspace folder.

dictml.trace.server.description: Log LSP traffic to the ML Dictionary output channel.
